portal_hypertension.abstract: To evaluate the feasibility and early postprocedural hemorrhage outcomes of absorbable gelatin sponge (AGS) torpedo tract closure and to briefly describe the tract-closure method used following portal vein recanalization in pediatric native-liver extrahepatic portal vein obstruction. We retrospectively reviewed the cases of 18 consecutive children [11 boys, 7 girls; median age, 7 years (range, 5-12)] treated between 2020 and 2025 who underwent transsplenic and/or trans-hepatic portal vein recanalization with planned tract embolization using AGS torpedoes. portal_hypertension.abstract: In patients with portal vein thrombosis (PVT), hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) does not accurately reflect portal pressure. This study aimed to evaluate the application of endoscopic ultrasound (EUS)-guided portal pressure gradient (PPG) in cirrhotic patients with PVT. In patients with cirrhosis who had gastroesophageal varices (GEV) and PVT were included. The PPG proximal to the PVT (Pro-PVT PPG), PPG distal to the PVT (Dis-PVT PPG), and gastric variceal pressure gradient (GVPG) were measured by puncturing the target vessels under the guidance of EUS.
